# Glitz & Glamour Studio

> Luxury nail, hair, beauty, and bridal studio in San Marcos, CA — led by Jojo.

## About
Glitz & Glamour Studio is a premier full-service beauty studio and bridal headquarters at 935 W San Marcos Blvd, Suite 101, San Marcos, CA 92078 (serving San Marcos, Vista, Escondido, Carlsbad, Oceanside, and North County San Diego). We specialize in luxury nail artistry (Apres Gel-X, sculpted acrylics, rubber-base structured manicures, detox spa pedicures), custom hair color and cuts (lived-in balayage, dimensional foil highlights, gloss toners, vivid color, women's & kids' haircuts), customized facials, female waxing (Brazilian, bikini, brow & facial waxing), and on-location bridal & quinceañera hair and makeup.

- Phone: [+1 (760) 290-5910](tel:+17602905910)
- Email: [info@glitzandglamours.com](mailto:info@glitzandglamours.com)
- Instagram: [@glitzandglamourstudio](https://www.instagram.com/glitzandglamourstudio/)
- Physical Address: [935 W San Marcos Blvd, Suite 101, San Marcos, CA 92078](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Glitz+%26+Glamour+Studio+935+W+San+Marcos+Blvd+Suite+101+San+Marcos+CA+92078)

## Service Category Hubs
- [Nail Salon Services](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/services/nails): Gel-X extensions ($60+), acrylic full sets ($65+), structured rubber-base gel manicures ($40+), fills ($35+), rebalances ($55+), and gentle soak-offs.
- [Detox & Spa Pedicures](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/services/pedicures): Classic Foot Soak Detox pedicures ($65+), Jelly Hydrating Foot Detox ($75+), and full set acrylic toes ($45+).
- [Hair Color & Haircuts](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/services/hair): Custom lived-in balayage ($380+), dimensional highlights ($380+), solid color ($120+), gloss toners ($65+), creative/vivid color, women's haircuts ($65+), and kids' cuts ($35+).
- [Waxing & Brow Shaping](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/services/waxing): Female Brazilian & bikini waxing ($60+), precision eyebrow waxing ($12+), underarm ($20+), sideburns ($15+), and upper lip ($10+).
- [Facials & Skincare](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/services/facials): Express mini facials ($30+), custom nourishing facials ($75+), deep cleansing + extraction facials ($85+), and anti-aging enzyme facials ($100+).

Studio appointments can be booked 24/7 online at [Online Booking](https://www.glitzandglamours.com/book) or by calling/texting [+1 (760) 290-5910](tel:+17602905910). Lash inquiries are handled directly with Jojo by phone/text.
